sourceArticle.title: Get Started With Prism.fm - Live Music Management Software
sourceArticle.author: Matt Ford - Founder and CEO

athenaOutput.directive: Transform Prism.fm from a third-party SaaS tool into a sovereign, automated extension of the artist's touring infrastructure, ensuring absolute financial transparency and operational autonomy through API-first cognitive integration.
athenaOutput.rationale: Live music logistics and settlements are historically plagued by opaque accounting, manual drudgery, and asymmetric data ownership favoring promoters over artists. In accordance with Article XXV (Integration Over Reverse-Engineering), we will not rebuild Prism.fm's core scheduling or financial engines. Instead, we will build robust API adapters and orchestration wrappers around Prism.fm. This allows the Creative Liberation Engine to extract, analyze, and act upon touring data autonomously, returning leverage and time to the artist while adhering to Article XX (Zero human wait time).

options.title: The Sovereign Data Bridge (Data Portability & Ownership)
options.description: Establish a one-way, continuous synchronization pipeline from Prism.fm's API into the artist's local sovereign data warehouse (NAS). This extracts all calendar, ticketing, and financial settlement data into an immutable local ledger.
options.tradeoffs: Requires robust error handling and rate-limit management with Prism's API. High initial infrastructure setup, but guarantees that if the artist leaves Prism, they retain 100% of their historical touring intelligence.

options.title: The Automated Promoter (Cognitive Wrapper)
options.description: Deploy an LLM-driven orchestration layer over Prism.fm. The artist simply commands: 'Book a 5-city West Coast run in October.' The system interfaces with Prism to check venue avails, calculate estimated costs based on historical data, and draft preliminary offers.
options.tradeoffs: Highly complex orchestration. Risk of hallucinated routing if historical data is sparse. However, it completely eliminates the manual data entry bottleneck in tour planning.

options.title: Zero-Wait Auto-Settlement Engine
options.description: Automate the night-of-show settlement process. As ticketing data hits Prism.fm, the Creative Liberation Engine instantly reconciles promoter expenses against ticket revenue, generating an immediate, transparent payout report for the artist's management.
options.tradeoffs: Relies heavily on the accuracy and timeliness of third-party ticket system integrations within Prism. If garbage data enters, garbage settlements are produced. Requires LEX agent oversight for contract compliance.

options.title: On-Prem Biometric Run-of-Show (RoS) Integration
options.description: Sync Prism.fm's Run-of-Show schedules with localized, on-prem biometric access control systems at the venue. Crew and artists are granted physical access based on the Prism schedule, processed entirely locally with zero cloud biometric export.
options.tradeoffs: Requires physical hardware integration at venues and strict adherence to Article XXIV (Biometric Data Sovereignty). High friction for deployment but ultimate security and privacy for high-profile artists.

options.title: Predictive Tour Routing Intelligence
options.description: Ingest historical Prism.fm data (ticket scaling, demographic turnout, local expenses) to train local sovereign models. These models predict the most profitable routing and venue sizing for future tours before offers are ever submitted.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant historical data volume to be accurate. High compute cost for model training, but offers massive strategic leverage in tour negotiations.

options.title: Rebuild Prism.fm Core Features
options.description: Attempt to clone Prism.fm's calendar, offer generation, and settlement math natively within the Creative Liberation Engine to avoid using a third-party SaaS altogether.
options.tradeoffs: Direct violation of Article XXV (Integration over Reverse-Engineering). Wastes engineering cycles on solved problems instead of building higher-order intelligence.
